identity.title: Palo Verde Nuclear Generating Station (PVNGS) Unit 3 Docket No. STN 50-530 Licensee Event Report 2025-002-00

cause.proximate_text: The Service Air Containment Isolation Valve was rendered inoperable due to human performance errors. Prior to entering the modes of applicability this valve should have been identified as open on the mode change checklist. The procedural guidance is information use and, although referenced, this did not ensure recognition of the TS applicability for this valve. This was a procedure use and adherence error.
cause.theme: procedure use and adherence error / mode change checklist failure

nodes.display_name: Open valve not identified on mode change checklist
nodes.description: Prior to entering the modes of applicability, the manual isolation valve should have been identified as open on the mode change checklist but was not.

nodes.display_name: Manual isolation valve not closed/locked per procedure
nodes.description: The manual isolation valve for Service Air to Containment was not signed as closed and locked per the Locked Valve, Breaker, and Component Tracking procedure.

nodes.display_name: No administrative controls established while valve open in applicable modes
nodes.description: During the modes of applicability until the valve was closed, no administrative controls were established for the intermittently open manual containment isolation valve.

nodes.display_name: TS LCO 3.6.3 Condition A violated / required actions and completion times not met
Close, lock, and independently verify Service Air Containment Isolation Valve
Conduct briefings on procedural adherence with focus on attention to detail
Additional training on reviewing the Locked Valve Book
TS Bases Revision 82, Containment Isolation Valves B 3.6.3
